test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 9 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
The following are the weights (in kg) of 25 students:

58, 55, 53, 50, 53, 51, 52, 54, 53, 52, 54, 53, 58, 53, 59, 55, 53. 52, 51, 54, 53, 59, 55, 53, 52

Among the following options, what is the weight (in kg) that appears least number of times in the given data?
solution:
Given:

The following are the weights (in kg) of 25 students:

58, 55, 53, 50, 53, 51, 52, 54, 53, 52, 54, 53, 58, 53, 59, 55, 53, 52, 51, 54, 53, 59, 55, 53, 52

Calculation:

Weights of the 25 students in ascending order are as follow:

50, 51, 51, 52, 52, 52, 52, 53, 53, 53, 53, 53, 53, 53, 53, 54, 54, 54, 55, 55, 55, 58, 58, 59, 59

Weight 50 kg has the lowest frequency, 1 in the given set of data values. 

**∴ 50 kg appears least number of times in the given data. **
